subject: Re: CMMD kickoff — replacing FID in Evalline
body:
Status.

Implementation: done and validated — our production CMMD matches the reference implementation to 4 decimal places on the paper's test cases. The unbiased MMD estimator means no more "FID needs 50k samples" folklore: CMMD is stable at a few thousand images, which alone will save teams real eval compute. Also handled the offline case: CLIP ViT-L/14@336px weights are mirrored internally so air-gapped eval jobs don't attempt the auto-download.

Evalline integration (Amara): metric endpoint merged, side-by-side CMMD/FID reporting works in staging.

One finding worth surfacing: on our internal gen-model leaderboard, CMMD and FID disagree on the #2/#3 ordering. We expected this (it's the paper's whole point — FID can contradict human raters) but expect noise from affected teams. Suggest we pre-brief them rather than let them find out on the dashboard.

Katya
